Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
I see Old Sir Douglas is living and thriving once more, so I write to ask whether you wish for the first instalment of the [Chaplet of Pearls](/book/69) for October, or whether you wish to wait till the end of one of the present stories.[^1] I have written almost to the end, but it wants plenty of re-touching. I have had so much interruption that I /often\ could not go into work that took more study - however I have made a beginning for the [Worthies](/book/80) and have finished the first.
I hope your party are pretty well, and [Mrs Daniel](/person/941) in a less anxious state

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
What a delightful paper that is on the Verney portraits


[^1]: Chapters of Caroline Norton’s Old Sir Douglas appeared in [Macmillan’s Magazine](/periodical/78) from January to May 1866, and then from September 1866 to October 1867. The Chaplet of Pearls was serialized from November, 1867 to December 1868.
